about.title: Why KaarYab Afghanistan exists
about.description: KaarYab helps Afghan job seekers find trusted opportunities in one organized platform.

problem.title: Problem
problem.body: Opportunities are often scattered across social media, groups, and different websites.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: KaarYab centralizes opportunities with search, filters, saved items, and organization pages.

audience.title: Audience
audience.body: Students, graduates, job seekers, women seeking remote work, and organizations sharing listings.

summary.title: Built as a practical job platform
summary.body: The application includes responsive layouts, dynamic routes, saved opportunities, organization profiles, a full add/edit/delete workflow, dark mode, and reusable components so it feels ready for everyday use.

highlights.title: What the platform brings together
highlights.description: KaarYab keeps the main pieces of a job search in one place so users can move faster and stay organized.

search.title: Search and filter
search.body: Find opportunities by title, location, company, type, deadline, and more.

save.title: Save for later
save.body: Keep interesting opportunities in one place and revisit them anytime.

directory.body: Review the organizations and institutions behind active listings.

workflow.title: How KaarYab works
workflow.description: The platform follows a simple workflow that keeps discovery, saving, and applying easy to follow.
